hero.title: File:Beecher Bible and Rifle Church.jpg
hero.credit: Library of Congress, Prints and Photograph Division Historic American Buildings Survey HABS: KANS,99-WABAU,1-1
hero.description: Entrance of the Beecher Bible and Rifle Church, located at the southeastern corner of the intersection of Chapel and Elm Sts. in Wabaunsee, Wabaunsee County, Kansas, United States.  Built in 1862, the church was added to the National Register of Historic Places on 24 February 1971.  Its name is derived from the congregation itself: supported in its founding by Henry Ward Beecher, it was active in abolitionism during the Bleeding Kansas and Civil War eras.
